title: Unification of Egypt
description: Upper and Lower Egypt are joined under one king, traditionally Menes and often identified with Narmer.

title: Great Pyramid of Giza
description: The pyramid of Khufu, built over about 26 years, remains the tallest structure on Earth for nearly four thousand years.

title: Hyksos expelled
description: Ahmose I drives out the foreign rulers of the Delta and founds the New Kingdom.

title: Akhenaten founds Amarna
description: The pharaoh builds a new capital for the worship of the sun disc Aten alone, abandoned soon after his death.

title: Battle of Kadesh
description: Ramesses II fights the Hittites in the best-recorded battle of the Bronze Age; neither side wins outright.

title: Persian conquest
description: Cambyses II defeats Psamtik III and makes Egypt a province of the Persian Empire.

title: Alexandria founded
description: Alexander the Great founds the city that becomes the capital of Ptolemaic Egypt and a centre of Greek learning.

title: Death of Cleopatra
description: After defeat by Octavian the last Ptolemaic ruler kills herself, and Egypt becomes a Roman province.

title: Arab conquest
description: Amr ibn al-As takes Egypt from the Byzantines for the caliphate and founds Fustat as its capital.

title: Cairo founded
description: The Fatimids conquer Egypt and build a new capital beside Fustat.

title: Saladin ends the Fatimid caliphate
description: Saladin abolishes the Shia caliphate and founds the Ayyubid dynasty.

title: Mamluks take power
description: Slave soldiers overthrow the last Ayyubid sultan and rule Egypt until 1517.

title: Battle of Ain Jalut
description: The Mamluks defeat a Mongol army, stopping the Mongol advance into Africa.

title: Battle of the Pyramids
description: Napoleon's army defeats the Mamluks and occupies Cairo.

title: Muhammad Ali becomes governor
description: The Ottoman officer takes control of Egypt and founds a dynasty that rules until 1952.

title: Suez Canal opens
description: The canal joins the Mediterranean and the Red Sea, shortening the route between Europe and Asia.

title: Battle of Tel El Kebir
description: British troops defeat the army of Ahmed Urabi and begin an occupation that lasts in some form until 1956.

title: Independence declared
description: Britain unilaterally ends its protectorate, keeping control of defence and the canal.

title: Tutankhamun's tomb found
description: Howard Carter's workmen uncover the first step of the only nearly intact royal tomb found in the valley.

title: Second Battle of El Alamein
description: The British Eighth Army begins the offensive that drives German and Italian forces out of Egypt.

title: Revolution of 1952
description: The Free Officers overthrow King Farouk, and Egypt becomes a republic the next year.

title: Suez Canal nationalised
description: Gamal Abdel Nasser announces the takeover of the canal company, leading to the Suez Crisis.

title: Aswan High Dam completed
description: The dam ends the yearly Nile flood and supplies power and water for irrigation.

title: Assassination of Sadat
description: Islamist soldiers kill President Anwar Sadat at a military parade.

title: Mubarak resigns
description: Eighteen days of mass protest end Hosni Mubarak's thirty years as president.

title: Military removes Morsi
description: The army under Abdel Fattah el-Sisi deposes the elected president, Mohamed Morsi.
